role_summary: Designs, automates and operates cloud infrastructure: compute, networking, identity and deployment pipelines, usually defined as code.

postings.title: Software Engineer L2 – Cloud Infrastructure
postings.summary: Cloud infrastructure engineer managing AWS compute at scale, automating operations and applying infrastructure-as-code practices, with an on-call rotation.
responsibilities: Develop solutions for distributed infrastructure problems with architects and leads
Automate monitoring, capacity planning and disaster response
Apply infrastructure-as-code standards and write design docs and runbooks
Participate in on-call for business-critical infrastructure
requirements: 2+ years managing AWS infrastructure (EC2, AMIs, IAM)
Strong knowledge of auto scaling groups
Shell scripting and at least one programming language
Experience with IaC and continuous deployment tooling

postings.title: Specialist Solutions Architect – Cloud Infrastructure & AWS
postings.summary: Customer-facing cloud architect guiding enterprise deployments on AWS: networking, identity, security, automation and platform operations.
responsibilities: Guide strategic customers through AWS deployments from design to production
Architect secure deployments across AWS networking and identity
Act as subject-matter expert on AWS infrastructure and IaC
Feed customer requirements back into product direction
requirements: 6+ years in solutions architecture or a senior hands-on technical role
Advanced AWS security, identity and enterprise networking
Hands-on IaC with Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK
Strong Python and SQL, including live coding
